report:
KEY engine is finished, and every check I ran in the engine's own scope passes. Games run on DEMO credits only. These credits have no cash value and are never linked to the USDT ledger, wallet, pool or fee ledgers. There is no fee on game bets ("Fees 0.00").

What was built:

1) `@gp/shared/fair` (new subpath, exported in package.json and tsup; added dependency `@noble/hashes@1.8.0`, the same version viem uses). Files are in `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/packages/shared/src/fair/`.
- `stream.ts`: the HMAC-SHA256 byte stream (key = server seed, message = `clientSeed:nonce:cursor`). It provides `uniformInt` (rejection sampling, so no modulo bias), `scaleU32` (an exact `floor(u32×n/2^32)` for published "f × n" formulas; precision is documented), `nextU52` (BigInt), forward Fisher–Yates, and commit/verify.
- `credits.ts`: DEMO credit constants plus stake and payout helpers. All maths uses decimal.js; payouts are truncated to 6 decimals.
- `games/*`: pure rule functions and payout tables for Pool Dice (#34), Double Side, Pool Roulette (#35: `pocket = floor(f×37)`, all bet types including zero bets, 5,000.00 table maximum), Orbit Rush (#42: hash chain, 1-in-100 instant crash, 1,000.00× cap, decimal.js curve `m(t)=e^(0.1117t)`), Twenty-One, Skyline, Fortune Ring, Pool Keno, Pinfall, Vault Sweeper and High Card.
  - Twenty-One: 6 decks, S17, 3:2, double after split, split once, split Aces get one card, dealer peeks, insurance 2:1, lazy forward Fisher–Yates shoe.
- `catalogue.ts`: published limits, edges, rule versions and reference prefixes.
- `schemas.ts`: zod request schemas.
- `play.ts`: `playInstant()` and `verifyBet()`, the same code the browser verifier will use.
- `vectors.json`: test vectors whose HMAC blocks were computed independently with node:crypto.
- Tests in `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/packages/shared/test/fair/` (stream, vectors, rules, rtp). The RTP tests prove each game's RTP exactly over its whole outcome space, then run Monte-Carlo checks with fixed seeds (100k–200k bets per game, including Twenty-One played with basic strategy).

2) Prisma: additive migration `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261128190000_games_engine`.
- New tables: `demo_credit_accounts` and `demo_credit_entries` (a trigger rejects any UPDATE), `crash_chains`, `crash_rounds`, `crash_bets`.
- Existing tables reused and extended:
  - `game_sessions` is the seed pair; it gains `server_seed_enc`, the server seed encrypted with AES-GCM while the pair is active.
  - `game_results` is the bet; it gains user and game ids, a reference number, status, multiplier, currency, params, server-held state, rules version, idempotency key and settled time.
- Partial unique indexes: one active seed pair per player and game, one active round per player and game, one live crash round.
- Existing DEMO history rows were backfilled. After applying it to the dev DB, the Prisma diff against the schema is empty.

3) API, in `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/api/src/modules/games/` (`engine/*`, `play.controller.ts`, `admin-games.controller.ts`, `games.module.ts`, plus `games.service.ts` extended with a `play` block).
- Credits: `GET /games/credits` (balance, plus session and today totals for the RG/Session Bar) and `POST /games/credits/reset` (once per hour, audited).
- Seeds: GET seeds, change client seed, rotate. Rotating reveals the old server seed and is refused while a round is open.
- Instant games: `POST/GET /games/:slug/bets` (idempotent).
- Bets: `GET /games/bets/:id` and `/verify`. The API re-derives the outcome itself once the seed is revealed.
- Stateful games: Twenty-One hands (actions hit, stand, double, split, insurance; a current-hand endpoint for reconnect), Vault Sweeper (reveal, cash out), High Card (call, skip, cash out).
- Orbit Rush REST: state, rounds, public verify, bets, cash out.
- socket.io `/crash`: snapshot, phase, 100 ms ticks, bets, cash-outs and crash events; bet and cash-out over the socket use the same checks as REST.
- Crash loop: an interval loop that runs only with `JOBS_ENABLED`, with one leader replica chosen through a Redis lease. `tick(now)` is also the manual helper tests call, with a pinned `GameClock`.
- Admin, read-only (`games.read`): `/admin/games/overview` (measured vs published RTP), `/admin/games/bets`, `/admin/games/orbit-rush/rounds`.
- Server-side policy on every new bet:
  - gaming policy: onboarding, region (451), self-exclusion and cooling-off (403), `gaming_blocked`;
  - RG time rules;
  - a due reality check blocks the next bet (409 `REALITY_CHECK_DUE`), never mid-round;
  - the loss limit, counted in DEMO credits;
  - bet min/max and table limits; DEMO balance (422 `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`);
  - REAL_MONEY guard: any non-DEMO currency or non-simulation game is refused with 403 `REAL_MONEY_DISABLED`;
  - idempotency keys and a per-IP bet throttle (`GAMES_BET_THROTTLE_LIMIT`, added to `.env.example`).

4) Docs: new `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/docs/GAMES.md` (API contract per game, fairness formulas, house edges, limits, DEMO-credit policy, decisions). `docs/API.md` has a new games section and the `/crash` socket section; `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` had one line updated.

Figma: I used 6 of the 15 allowed screenshots (GM-03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08) to read the P2 payout and rule numbers. They are saved in `/home/user/Claude/design/reference/games/`. I built no web pages (none are in this key's scope), so there are no Playwright screenshots or web e2e from me.

- Every one of these screens is PARTIAL overall, because their UI belongs to the other keys.
- PUB-04 only needs the catalogue `play` block, which is implemented.

decisions: DEMO credits instead of USDT everywhere in games (owner instruction). The Figma frames show wallet USDT; the UI must mirror the layout but show 'DEMO credits · no cash value' (deviation to note on every game screen)
Pool Dice multiplier = 99 ÷ chance TRUNCATED to 4 dp, so under 50.50 gives 1.9603× instead of Figma #34's 1.9604×. This guarantees the published 1.00% edge is never undercut
Pool Dice win chance 0.01–98.00% (decision #34 / DI frames); the PUB-04 copy says 1–98%, so the copy needs aligning
Twenty-One min bet 1.00 (BJ frames); PUB-04 says 0.10, conflict flagged. A pair for splitting = same value (e.g. K+Q)

Pinfall / Keno / Fortune Ring: the designed tables (16·Medium, 6-pick Classic, Medium·30) are kept exactly; all other tables were generated by me with exact RTP ≤ 99.00% (Keno 98.65–99.00%, Pinfall 98.98–99.00%, wheels exactly 99.00%). The designers' Pinfall 16·Medium returns 99.016% (edge 0.98%); the owner can change 100×→94× if strict 1% is wanted
High Card edge applied per call (GM-08 copy), so a k-call run returns 0.99^k. Max payout 100,000.00 applied to Vault Sweeper (GM-03 copy) and to High Card for consistency

Orbit Rush: exactly 1 in 100 rounds is an instant crash; including rounds that bust before 1.01×, about 1.98% of rounds show 1.00×, which is mathematically forced by a 1% edge at every target. Crash salt is public per chain; nonce 0; chain length 10,000

RG: the loss limit also applies to DEMO play, counted separately in DEMO credits; the participation limit stays USDT-only; a due reality check (pause on) blocks the next bet with 409; continuing an open round (hit/stand/reveal/cash-out) is allowed while self-excluded, but stake-adding actions are not
Changing the client seed rotates the pair (reveals the old server seed); both are refused while a stateful round is open
Server seeds are AES-GCM encrypted at rest while active (reusing the TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY pattern already used for round salts)
Crash bets live in crash_bets (there is no per-player seed pair), so /history/game-rounds (rg-history module) does not list Orbit Rush; GET /games/orbit-rush/bets covers it
Admin monitoring is a games-module controller under /admin/games using the exported AdminModule guards; admin files are unchanged
Opening the seeds panel (GET /games/:slug/seeds) creates the player's first seed pair, so /history/games may list that game with 0 bets
